page.overview:
What is Barty Crouch Sr?

Forbidden Forest, Hogwarts grounds, Highlands, Scotland, Great Britain

Bartemius "Barty" Crouch Senior (d. 27 May 1995) was a British pure-blood wizard, the father of Bartemius Crouch Junior, and an influential British Ministry of Magic official during the mid-to-late 20th century.

He was the Head of the Department of Magical Law Enforcement during the First Wizarding War and a candidate for Minister for Magic. He had a reputation for "fighting fire with fire", exhibiting the sort of ruthlessness and brutality against criminals that could be compared to some Death Eaters to their victims.

He was cast aside after the First Wizarding War and was put in charge of Department of International Magical Co-operation. He was eventually murdered by his Death Eater son, Bartemius Crouch Junior, who despised him. He and his son were the last members of the pure-blood Crouch family.
